sources.title: The Future of Jobs Report 2025 - Skills outlook
sources.author: World Economic Forum
sources.annotation: The employer survey anticipates changing skill needs through 2030 and emphasizes analytical, technical, creative, and adaptive capabilities. I use it to justify a mixed competency map, while treating employer expectations as forecasts rather than guaranteed outcomes.

sources.title: Anthropic Economic Index: AI's impact on software development
sources.author: Anthropic
sources.annotation: This analysis examines 500,000 coding interactions and distinguishes task automation from collaboration with developers. It helps me examine how implementation work could change, but it does not measure final code quality or prove productivity gains.

sources.title: GDC 2026 State of the Game Industry Reveals Impact of Layoffs, Generative AI, and More
sources.author: Beth Elderkin
sources.annotation: The official survey summary describes AI use, employment pressures, and contrasting attitudes among game-industry professionals. I use it to challenge the assumption that easier production automatically means easier entry into games, while recognizing that respondents do not represent every studio.

sources.title: Applied AI Demo Engineer
sources.author: Anthropic
sources.annotation: This employer listing combines LLM applications, retrieval, integrations, reliable prototypes, and technical communication. I use its duties as one concrete role comparison rather than an entry-level promise or a universal definition of AI engineering.
